findings.reason: Replaced the vague unit clause with explicit c=1 and SI conventions for the generator flow parameter, surface gravity, Lagrangian density, n-dimensional Newton coupling, Noether charge, Hamiltonian, and entropy; also stated covariance of the first-variation decomposition.

Added the curvature sign convention and weight-one antisymmetrization, and made explicit that pullback variations of full covariant matter jets include the connection variation. This closes the higher-derivative-of-generator gap in the local charge argument; compare Iyer–Wald §§3–4, https://arxiv.org/pdf/gr-qc/9403028.

Replaced the reflection-parity shortcut with a local null normal-frame boost-weight argument for the pullback components of form-valued X. It shows why mixed normal-tangent components vanish; compare Iyer–Wald §6, Eqs. (100)–(102), https://arxiv.org/pdf/gr-qc/9403028.

Strengthened f to C∞ on an open interval containing every curvature value throughout the admitted spacetime and smooth-family domain, matching the supplier's smooth-Lagrangian hypotheses; compare Iyer–Wald §2, https://arxiv.org/pdf/gr-qc/9403028.

The consumer allows bulk dimension d+1 for d≥2 but fixes SI Newton-constant units m³ kg⁻¹ s⁻² and area units m², which fit only d=3. Owner repair must restrict it to four spacetime dimensions or use area units m^(d−1) and G_(d+1) units m^d kg⁻¹ s⁻².

Its formulation-prerequisite edge to the AdS entropy dictionary is out of scope: that dictionary requires d≥2, while the JT model is two-dimensional (d=1), and the JT statement separately adopts its disk density. Owner reconciliation is needed for this item edge and the page edge tgrx-ads-effective-boundaries → tgrx-jt-disk-model.
